newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end higher in volatile trade.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end higher in volatile trade.

text.p: Madrid shares ended sharply higher on Monday, backed by strong gains on other bourses in somewhat volatile trade, dealers said.
The outlook still seen dominated by foreign market performance, with Ibex resistance at 7,200 seen holding firm.

The bank sector continued to be the highlight of the bourse, with second-largest bank Banco Bilbao Vizcaya up 400 pesetas, or 3.09 percent, to 13,340, benefitting from switching out of other banks, dealers said.
But analysts said this was not a feasible explanation for the fall in Santander, which fell 45 pesetas, near one percent, to 4,650 pesetas.
The general index closed up 5.73 points, 0.92 percent, to 625.52, while the Ibex-35 index of leading shares added 72.01 points, 1.02 percent, to 7,136.13.
